title: Transcript, waveform, captions, analysis candidates, and reversible editing
objective: Preserve immutable source truth while derived transcript, analysis, composition, edit, render, and published-version states evolve reversibly.

obligations.title: Source artifact, tokens, transcript revisions, candidates, compositions, edits, renders, and published versions remain distinct
obligations.residualRisk: Transcript cleanup or AI editing can overwrite source truth or make a destructive change appear reversible.

obligations.title: Transcription, waveform, VAD, silence, candidate fusion, and rendering are queued, metered, portable, and backpressured
obligations.residualRisk: Expensive analysis can exceed budget, provider, or capacity limits and produce untraceable candidates.

obligations.title: Models, prompts, thresholds, source checksums, decisions, and renders support calibrated evaluation and deterministic replay
obligations.residualRisk: An AI edit cannot be explained, reproduced, calibrated, or safely rolled back without complete lineage.

slos.indicator: Analysis candidates with complete source and pipeline lineage
Precision required before a detector may claim high confidence
